balls.text: This was like Misbah from the 2007 final, but the bowler is Bumrah not Harbhajan. The pace-on yorker was attempted, it zoomed in at the stumps. The length might've been inches off. Ramandeep tried to put Bumrah off by faking a swing across the line before going back to his regular stance. Bumrah stuck to his plan but got launched over long-on
Ramandeep took off as Starc clipped the full ball to deep square leg. 143ks
Yorker at the stumps, worked to long-on. Bumrah as good as expected so far. 150 up for KKR
Full toss just under the knee-roll. Starc was maybe weary of the yorker and couldn't adjust to capitalise, ends up gently patting it towards cover

The angle is sharp and the slower one nicks off Rinku. Full and slow, delivered from cover again, Rinku cleared the front foot and tried slugging over long-on. Got a thick edge that ballooned to the keeper's left
On-pace yorker attempted. The low fully is almost there, clipped to midwicket
Very low full toss on leg, Rinku picks it up and gets it into the midwicket outfield. Fielder charges across and stops it close to the ropes.
Sweet yorker just outside off, Ramandeep gets on one knee and steers it to deep third

Length ball outside off is called a wide. MI review. Ramandeep went across a bit before backing away and slashing. Didn't make contact, ball was along if not just outside the tramline. Decision will stay

Goes across, top edges a slog sweep over fine leg. Was an offcutter, in the slot but Thushara probably saw Ramandeep go across and maybe tried to get it away from the arc. He tried to go square, the fielders behind square were all in the ring, so it went for four
Middle-stump yorker this time. 136ks. Slinger tailed away a bit, Rinku opened the face late to squirt it to deep third
Wide yorker is just a little further forward from the crease, all Ramandeep can do it guide it to deep point
Yorker on middle and off, nailed, dabbed to deep point.
Length around fourth, tries to pick it up square again. Can't middle it, gets it off the bottom part of the bat towards square leg

Slot ball has been phatted, if I heard Danny Morrison correctly, over square leg. Stayed deep in the crease and waited for that slowish fuller one to come in front of him. The feet buckled, the head came down and the hands swiped across
Goes back and tries to cut it late, misses. Length ball angling away through fifth, Rinku using his back leg more before reaching out with the hands. Doesn't get enough room
Ramandeep tries the same thing but the 139ks low fully follows him. It's patted towards deep midwicket but with a bit too much pace for two to be on
Steals two to deep midwicket. Length ball has been worked to the outfield after stepping outside off
Back of length outside off, guided to deep third

High, very very high, and not far enough. Chawla's bumper does the trick. 117ks long-hop just outside off, Russell was springing in his crease and tried to pull it into oblivion but got hurried just a bit. His feet got jammed in the end, a sign of being cramped for room. Was enough to find the top edge, Kamboj was a few metres in from the deep-midwicket boundary and took it with ease. Chawla goes SRK mode with his celebrations, hands spread apart, as Russell sighs in disappointment
Backs away and cuts the length ball on top of off to the sweeper
Full and slow, slog swept just wide of long-on
Length outside off, cut to point
Dances down, reaches out and boshes it over cow corner. Was looped up on the fuller side of length, Rinku reached further away forward, back leg lifted up to crank him further to get him to the pitch
Full on off, opens the face and pushes it to point

Rana caught napping for a moment, goes through with the single. Direct hit at the non-striker's end. Has he made it? No, the bat is just behind the crease as the stumps lit up. Replays show it might be miscommunication with Russell also stopping for a bit. Was a fullish slower ball following Rana as he made room, he opened the face and guided it. Pity that. Rana was so good against MI's best bowler but that match-up won't continue till Bumrah's final over

Goes for another pacy yorker but ends up delivering a shin-high full toss that Rana manages to whip away. No one at deep midwicket, SKY chased valiantly and dove in desperation, didn't get near it. Lighting outfield, even better are Rana's reflexes and anticipation. He stayed deep in the crease, got low and forced it
Bumrah, almost inevitably, gets him lbw very next ball. Finger went up right away. Reviewed by Rana. Looked salmon trout but it doesn't matter as the ball has pitched outside leg
Gamble works for Nitish. Mid-off was in, so he made room by clearing his front foot by a mile. The shortish ball decked away at pace, and the deviation worked for the flat-batted slap

Pacy and at the body. Keeps Russell in check. Shortish ball landed outside off and decked in sharply, came around chest-height and Russell almost squirmed as he nudged it off the sticker, towards midwicket
Shortish at the armpits, tucks him up, Rana gets the pull away to long leg

Four saved at backward point by Tilak. He moved early to the left and put in the big dive to intercept. Was a surprise military-medium bumper from Chawla. Maybe he saw Russell dance down, batter managed well to slap it but was denied a potential four
Charges and tries to lash it straight, but doesn't get to the pitch of the length ball. Ball goes off the inside edge to the leg side

Keeps a bit low to almost catch Dre Russ off guard. He manages to adjust and defend towards cover. Was a length ball around off to which the batter started making room before pushing back towards the line
Through-the-line muscling. Flatter 91kph ball was full on leg, Russell slid his feet down leg to make space and drove over the bowled. Cannoned away for four
Shortish outside off, clears the front leg and carves it to deep point.
Scampers back for two. Throw from deep third is taken by the keeper, bails taken off. Run-out referral made. Replay shows Rana had slid the bat in.

Run-out chance seems to have been missed. Ball was slapped to cover and Rana took off, probably responded to Russell's call. But Russell start-stopped and didn't run far. Chawla, at cover, was sharp. Thushara took a little while to get back to the stumps to try and dislodge the bails. It allowed enough time for Rana to get back
Pace-on and Russell monsters it over cover. Wide again from Thushara but the reach is too good. Very full and Russell was deep in the crease, but committed and depsited it 81 metres far
Wide and fullish, Rana goes real deep in the crease and swipes with the cross bat. Gets it off the edge to deep third
Rana tries to disrupt Thushara's plan by going for the reverse ramp. Got a full cutter just outside off, tried to scoop it late but didn't get in reach
Wide and fullish, that seems to be Thushara's plan. Slapped to long-on
Slow, full and wide. Rana is deep the crease and slashes it to deep point. Closer to the bottom
Wide yorker lands just outside the tramline. Let go

Dre Russ channels his inner Damien Martyn by easing the ball through cover for an effortless four. Was a bit too full and around off, Russell was legside of the ball to begin with, so he just stood still and showed it the full face
Fullish outside off, middles the defensive push to cover
Turns him into an S but Russell manages to defend with a straight bat.

Doesn't matter how the match-up is, if Russell sees it in his wheelhouse, he's going after it. Googly was fullish, drifting in, and gave air. That's what the batter wanted, went on one knee and slog-swept it effectively, over long-on
Fullish around fourth, defended towards cover

V Iyer does go hard but holes out to long-off. Danced down right away, pre-meditated, and tried to launch it downtown. Got it off the bottom of the bat and SKY took it around chest-height. V Iyer might be done for the game with the hamstring issue.

Goes across for the sweep, misses and gets hit on the pad. Hardik the only one confident in the lbw appeal. Not given, no review. Rana was across enough for all three stumps to be on display from front-on. Got hit on the outer-half of pad too. Easy call
Goes back and lays into the slower one. Into the pitch from Hardik, fourth-stump line, at the top of the stumps, Rana was deep in the crease and swivel-pulled it over midwicket.
Uses the pace and cuts the angle, chops it wide of backward point. Too square for deep third to cut it off. Length ball just outside off, Rana crouched a bit and broke his wrists with aplomb

V Iyer, as Harshith on scoring observed a little while ago, has been playing almost everything off the back foot. As he does here. Fullish ball around off, he goes back and taps it with a full face to the bowler's right
Goes back and picks it up from thigh-high. Gets it wide to the right of deep square leg. V Iyer pulling a length ball again, that too on the fuller side. Went deep in the crease and lifted it.
Length around off, Rana tries to defend it with bat almost jamming down into the flap of the pad. Ball goes right into the pitch below, single stolen

Dances down and tries to slash it over cover. Beaten comprehensively. He tried cutting the angle. The length ball was going away, towards sixth, V Iyer made a bit too much room in the end. Timeout taken by MI
Not that short but V Iyer pulls it well in front of deep square leg. He hobbles about, slows while turning. That left leg still seems to be an issue.
Fullish on the pads, 137ks, nudged towards midwicket for a quick run
Length on fifth, opens the face and taps it off the back foot to deep cover

Booming bouncer finds the edge, flies well over the keeper. V Iyer was deep in the crease and swivelled completely, got on one leg and was almost swerved far enough to kick the stumps, but he did well to rein himself in
Tries to heave it across the line. Doesn't get all of it, ball rolls to deep square leg
Ball keeps going away to beat the square drive. V Iyer trying to carve it without transferring weight and the length ball zipped past the edge
Down the pitch, tries belting it over cover. Gets beaten. Hardik still getting a bit of movement.

Too straight and it's four to fine leg. Tad back of length, lands around leg and decks in further. 130ks. V Iyer was standing outside leg and tried pulling it. May have gotten glove. Ball went wide of the keeper
Length on leg, clipped to the leg side
Extra bounce again. Back of length over middle and leg at 131ks, may have come in a bit. V Iyer's bottom hand came off as he tried to fend it across the line, deflects away for a single
Length on leg, tries to clip it. Gets it flush off the thigh pad to square leg

Magic ball, lands outside leg and goes over off from a hard length! Very little V Iyer could've done about that. He stayed in the crease and tried to defend it close to the body. Beaten on the outside edge.
Stays in the crease and tucks the length ball on leg to midwicket
Pitched up and that's driven sweetly through cover. No need for footwork. Rana just leans across to the fourth-stump ball and gets it past the infielder, diving to the left
Tries to defend the cutter, gets beaten on the outside edge
Length over off, defended square of the off side

Another boo boo, this time from S Iyer, who walks too far across and gets bowled. He was probably looking to meddle with Kamboj's line and maybe negate the movement off the pitch. Was deep in the crease and on off before the ball was delivered, went further away and the ball seamed in to go past the flick. It clipped the top of leg and Kamboj's hand went right up before he went into prayer
Being beaten doesn't stop the brave V Iyer from charging Bumrah and bouging a hard-length ball over mid-on.
Back towards perfection. Length ball lands around off and straightens, V Iyer has a poke before retracting bat. Gets beaten
Latches onto the leg-stump half-volley. Bumrah's angle works against him this time. Bumrah looked for the magic ball but it went straight and was flicked over midwicket.

Edged... goes over SKY at slip! He leapt up and timed the reach well but got only fingertips on it. Great seam position from Bumrah. Angled it in towards the wicket on a fullish length and it straightened. V Iyer tried to drive straight

Miscommunication as they take a single to point. Throw's at the striker's end. Ball seemed to have hit Venky, he went down. The pain seemed sharp as he wiggled about. He was sliding the bat into the crease and looked to have gotten hit a little further above the heel. Ugh, might actually be the hamstring. Physio runs out. Was a length ball over fourth, Shreyas went back and defended off the back foot towards backward point.

Jaffas deluxe from Bumrah. Channel ball straightens off a length. Shreyas is stuck in the crease and tries to defend straight. That's pure survival-based negotiation. Luckily it misses the outside edge.
Goes back in the crease and taps the length ball outside off, with an open face, towards point

Inside edge? Sounded like it. Kambojj is convinced it's an lbw. Hardik signals the inside edge. Was a seam-up ball on a full length that came in towards leg. S Iyer tried whipping it over midwicket and tickled it onto the back pad, ball rolled to square leg
Wide down the leg side.
A bit of extra bounce again. Fullish length and at the stumps, V Iyer tried defending and got the bottom hand off. Ball popped a few inches forward and they sneak a single

V Iyer keeps going. Don't matter two wickets are gone but with two wickets down and the shortened overs, it seems the rational option. He danced down to the length ball and slashed it over the bowler. High risk but greater aesthetics and reward of course.
Decks in, gets pace off the pitch. Length ball zips in towards top of leg stump, Shreyas gets his bottom hand off as he shaped to flick. Ball goes off the handle to the leg side
Length around off, defended to the off side

Wow, Bumrah - as ever - is on one. Gets the ball zipping off a fullish length, line's around off. Venky tries defending with low hands towards cover, gloves it towards slip. Soft hands meant it didn't fly
Heavy swing for Bumrah. Hits a length and ends up going a bit too straight. Ball beats the flick and deflects off the thigh pad to square leg
Length ball has been defended
Edged wide of the diving wide slip, too straight for deep third. Sweet length ball on top of middle, late swing squares up Shreyas. He tried defending straight, ball went off the shoulder of the bat
Test length but the line was slightly wide. Around sixth stump. Let go. Good carry to the keeper

Uh oh, that's a boo boo from Narine. Leaves an inswinging yorker on off, and the ball rattles off stump! This was the mini version of that nightmare Maxwell leave in the BBL. Bumrah going beyond the straight with the release, almost started from cover. It swerved late and dinked the outer-half of off stump. Narine had all stumps exposed and probably thought it'll keep going away. End-to-end grin from Bumrah. Dude's just too good a bowler even for peak, zen Narine. MI have blown out KKR's dangerous opening pair in seven balls.
Pitched up, driven through cover. Man in the ring dove to the left but made no contact. Was a fullish ball that Iyer drove lankily. Upper body was rather still, hands did most of the work

Thushara gets Salt with the slower one. Skied, Kamboj takes it at fine leg. The line and length - full and on middle and leg - gave the impression of being a slot ball. But the offcutter deceived Salt, who tried to pick it up square on the leg side. He crouched and swung fully, got a top edge. Felt for a second it might be a keeper's catch but was taken just in front of the stumps.
Wristy whip to midwicket. The wrists coiled up and twisted almost uncontrollably. Hovered low and went on the bounce. Ball was full on the pads
Looks for the hooping yorker, doesn't get the swing. Line's on leg stump, 130ks. Salt jams it towards midwicket
Peach of an outswinger beats bat. Similar length, line's tighter (around off). Salt wanted to whip it across off the front foot but finished tentatively.

Salt seemed to have gotten nothing on that but cleared the long-off boundary by a distance! Slinging outswinger was on the fuller side of length, angling towards sixth and Salt swiped across. Seemed to have gotten it off the bottom but it went... lol 94 metres far

KKR are through to the playoffs. With nine wins, they're the first to get up there and are likely to finish in the top two. Harshit has his wings spread out and soaks in the joy looking up. Was a length ball at the pads that was dinked towards midwicket
All Chawla can do is dab it to the off side.
Shortish ball outside off keeps going away. Chawla is unsure about playing or leaving, ends up trying a token ramp and is too late. Harshit's all but sealed it

Tilak throws the bedroom sink at it, edges to the keeper. Even Gautam Gambhir's smiling. He was standing with back foot deep in the crease, wide outside off, and front foot on leg, maybe shaped to heave it across but had to try and slap it as the length ball kept going away. Swung himself off into a bullwhip
Back of length outside off, Kamboj gets caught between a pull and a flick. Ball rolls towards backward point

Skied, Rinku takes it at deep midwicket. Big pop from the crowd! Harshit's pumping the air bending forward, his face isn't far from the ground. Naman went back in the crease and tried picking up the length ball, angling in towards him. Looked like a leading edge.

Salt slips and misses a potential chance! He started racing to the right, got two or three steps across, went back and then had to go forward - that's where he slipped. Tried reaching forward and with the gloves out. Made no contact. Was a wide length ball that Naman went across to and tried working legside. Got it off the edge/shoulder
Bad ball from Russell and it's carted over cover. Slot ball outside off, Russell tries to catapult it away from the batter but it well within Naman's reach. Drove with ease
Another low full toss, this one's been picked up with a follow-through. Sails over midwicket for an 80-metre six. Naman's doing better than Tilak.
Yorker on sixth, Naman shaped to paddle it but got followed. So he tried to guide it to third by opening the face. Ends up edging onto pad
No need for a follow-through when you can broom it like that!
Full and outside off, driven to long-off
Make that 40. Slower bumper is over the stumps, Tilak swivels and tries to serve it Tennis style

Flat batted but not in full control. Rolls to Starc at long-off. Wadhera didn't want two but Tilak didn't give him a choice. He wanted the strike back and Starc throws it on the bounce to Salt, who finishes the job! Maybe the communication could've been better. But KKR will take that. Replays show that Wadhera even changed his line
Around a length outside off, Tilak winds up a bit too much and swings a bit too hard. The mistimed pull/slog takes it to deep midwicket

MI are reversing back into this. This time, Tilak deploys it against a pacer. It is a cutter though and it was full and wide. The bounce meant he didn't middle it but the bat swing was going from down to up and he got it to the right of short third
Goes wide and full, Tilak tries to slap it towards cover. Can't connect
Slower one into the pitch. Outside off, it's dragged across with the pull. One hand came off but enough power for the ball to sail over square leg

Cutter is wide and slow. Tilak has his front foot well across but still has to reach out for the lofted paddle sweep, yeah that's quite the unbelievable shot. Not sure how he got so much power on it and cleared the infield
Wide yorker, just inside the tramline. Tilak goes across and jams it towards short third
Slow into a shortish length outside off, Wadhera shapes to cut it hard but stops midway. Ball pops up off the edge and falls in the gap between point and cover. 100 up
Makes room, clears the front leg. Has to reach out to the fullish ball outside off, oars it to deep point

Ramandeep runs in from deep midwicket and almost takes a stunner. He was charging and couldn't stop his momentum, ended up over-running and the ball burst through his fingers. Was a short ball that was pulled

Salt runs back and dives... but can't get near enough. Russell was ready to celebrate but smiles while retaining the excitement. Was a short ball just outside leg that Wadhera tried pulling. The ball spun off the bottom of the bat and went really fine. Salt was halfway into the dive but couldn't go through. Might not have been physically possible
On-pace bumper is high-ish and let go. HIgh enough to be called wide
KKR have one foot in the playoffs now. Slow, into the pitch does the trick! Short cutter was wide, spun back in and David tried to pull it hard. Got a top edge to deep midwicket
Squared up. David goes across and tries to defend it straight, the length ball lands around off and spun away sharply to hit the top of the thigh pad. Deflected to the off side
Length just outside off, patted with the open face to point

Chakravarthy gets MI's past and current captains. He's giving away nothing. No room, no bounce to work with, so Pandya has to manufacture it against a 100ks length ball rising to the top of the stumps. Backed away but not enough to middle it, the ball ballooned off the top edge of the heaving bat and was taken at short third.
Spins back in off a length. Starting line was around the tramline, Tilak's bat turned inwards as he whacked it to long-on
Keeps it away from the arc but wide called. Length ball along the tramline, Tilak seemed to go across and then tried dragging it across with a slog sweep. Missed it
Shortish and at the body, Pandya was ready for the pull and tried powering it. Didn't get all on it, ball rolls to midwicket
Length on off, flat, gets good bounce. Square punched off the back foot to cover point
Back of length just outside off, munched to cover

Heaved flat and straight to Ramandeep at deep square leg! Scramble-seam ball at 135ks, Russell's wrist pushed towards slip, maybe to try and get the ball further away. He hit a length and the line was around the off-side tramline. SKY was halfway into a squat and tried to kinda helicopter it. The wrists turned and the bat heaved but he couldn't elevate it. May have wanted to go finer too. In the end, it's Russell and Ramandeep celebrating jubilantly
Length on leg, clipped to deep fine leg
Dances down and makes room, tries to slap it but it bounces over the bat swing

This is full and forced inside out. Tilak cleared the front leg, so couldn't get his weight into the lofted drive, bat-face turned outwards too but the power took the ball well over the infield. With mid-off and cover in, the risk was in Tilak's favour
Shortish wide ball at 131ks is slapped to deep point. A loosener, as Matthew Hayden calls it. Gets away
Length on the pads, no turn, worked off the back foot to deep midwicket
Full on fourth, check driven to cover. SKY not confident, guessing he's just waiting for the pacers' overs
Full on leg, clipped over the ring (no one in) at midwicket. Long-on runs to the right and they manage to take two
Full around off from around the sticks, clipped to cow corner along the ground
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket
Rags away to bamboozle SKY. Fullish legbreak lands around leg, grips in the pitch and goes over middle. SKY tried to clip it square, missed it by a mile
Wide and full, driven to cover
Full on leg, whipped along the ground through midwicket
Full around fourth, driven to cover
Cut from a half-squat. Gets the fullish length ball on fifth wide to the left of the diving short-third fielder
Beats the cut and SKY falls across as he looks for support, the bat ends up laying flat in the end. Not that short or wide, SKY coiled up and went hard
Pushes the 96ks length ball to cover
Tilak also commits to the reverse-sweep plan. Tries to heave it fine but gets it off the gloves, Narine jumps and stretches out the left hand. Can't hold on

Rohit's struggle ends, Chakravarthy has worked him over. Rohit shaped to back away before returning to an upright position, tried to sweep the length ball angling towards him but the ball bounced more than he expected. The follow-through wasn't big but the top edge was enough to carry to short fine leg
Goes for another reverse, misses again! This was very full, just as flat around fourth stump. Beat him for pace, hit the pad
Pushes the full ball down the ground
Tries to carve the length ball on top of middle but doesn't get enough room. Chops it into the grass for a quick single towards point
The plan to reverse not working for Rohit here. he back leg went well outside off and he seemed to go square or even fine. Ball hit the pad.
Length just outside off, pushed to cover

Narine outfoxes Kishan with a 95ks slot ball and has the last laugh. The wobble on the ball upon release is more noticeable than the revs. Almost like a carrom ball and it was angled at the stumps, Kishan tried to power it over midwicket but hit it too flat. Fielder was well inside and took it easily. Narine has 550 T20 wickets
Kishan switches the stance again, goes for the reverse pull but gloves the ball towards the vacant short-leg area
Fullish ball is worked to the leg side for a quick two

Poor throw from Harshit from short third. Allows Rohit off the hook. Salt tried taking it one hand and didn't cope well with the ball scuttling to his right. Was a full ball just outside off that was reverse swept along the ground
Length just outside off, edges a cut to short third
Full and flattish just outside off, slapped to the right of deep cover

Gorgeous ball to beat the inside edge. Hits the pad, lbw not given. Seemed high. Shreyas discusses and KKR review. A bit of gap between bat and pad, hit Rohit high on the back leg but it was along top of knee-roll height when next to the front leg. No edge, what does ball tracking say? Length ball landed on fourth, impact was three-fourth of the way up middle, and it predicts to be going over leg stump. Review lost
Bit of extra bounce off the fuller side of length. Lands around fourth and turns away sharply, Rohit not at ease but manages to work it legside
Wide and slow, slapped off a length to the left of deep cover
Darted on a length at off, defended tentatively. Tried it with the closing bat face, got it closer to the leading edge
Flicks it off the back foot behind square
Kishan stays back in the crease and is ready for the top-of-pad high ball, swivel-pulls it over square leg for a biggie. Counterattack at its best

Switcheroo! A proper ode to Kevin Pietersen. Kishan not allowing Narine to hold onto his length, switched the stance right away, Narine may have seen him and went outside leg, but Kishan switched the grip and powered it up and over cover
Tad short and on leg, doesn't rise. Pace off the pitch is slow, so Kishan has ample time to wind up and pull it in front of square leg. Doesn't get all of it but enough for two
Gets big on Kishan and his pull, gets it off the bottom of the bat to midwicket
Carrom ball on a fullish length outside off,  Kishan tries to drive through cover, inside edges it towards midwicket
Sweeps the full ball to deep square leg
Picked up mightily over midwicket. Harshit probably looking for the yorker, bowls a half-volley on leg at 137ks. Kishan transferred the weight towards the line and got it flat
Wide on a fullish length. 138ks but looked slower on first view. Kishan pushes the weight onto the back foot, reaches out with the torso late, for the cut. Misses
Narine gets low to the left at point, tumbles and throws while rotating to save four. Crowd happy for him. Was a length ball just outside off that was cut
Slower one foxes Kishan. Was a wide length ball that drew him in to try and slash over cover.
Tries to carve the length ball angling away sharply. Gets a top edge that flies way over short third. That landed on off but went through (around) sixth-stump line

Cramped for room on the pull but Kishan commits and hits the midwicket outfield. Not that short a ball and Kishan's front foot sprung up and he swivelled on impact. Off the upper-half of the bat but powered well enough
Overpitched ouside off, square driven to point
Overpitched and it's launched over mid-off. Starc runs back, slides deep in the outfield and keeps it to two.
Wide slot ball is just inside the tramline and beats Rohit's slog across the line. Reach was the issue
Wide on a length, goes hard for the cut. Gets beaten
Fullish ball hits him on the glove. Decked back in, Rohit not using his feet much as he tries defending straight and with low hands.

High full toss and it's picked up over square leg for six. No-ball not given and Rohit reviews. Vaibhav is not able to control the ball, is dew playing its part?. Rohit's waist is 0.99 metres tall and the ball was 0.82 metres high as per ball-tracking. On-field call stays. Rohit stood along the crease, buckled his waist on impact and scuttled to the off side after managing to negotiate with it
Wide ball swings away past the tramline. Rohit reaches out with his torso and tries slapping it, gets nowhere close. Vaibhav not happy but that was wide

The ball swings wildly and goes through, probably, where second slip should have been! Umpires consult and call it a no-ball. Was a lowish full toss that started wide and kept swinging away. Wasn't in Rohit's postcode,
Full and swinging in, beats the flick. Deflects off the pads towards midwicket. Was sliding down leg
No one's stopping that as it's too fine. Length ball was outside off, Kishan leant back a bit and late cut it, up and under

Great fielding at deep-backward point from Ramandeep. He actually started from there and rabbited to the right, slid across and picked the ball up with both hands to save two. Was a shin-high full toss that was square driven
Swings it in from a fullish length. Finishes around off, Rohit notices the movement and decides to use just his hands (and not feet) to push it with the full face, towards mid-off
